initialization: raw reference frame zero and canonical finite-difference velocities
reference_velocity: centered generalized-position difference at plus/minus one source interval; one-sided at endpoints

failure.comparison: strict greater-than; absolute world-z errors; gravity z is normalized projected gravity, not angle

scoring_time: post-physics state at same reference timestamp, including exact final source timestamp
warning: Development protocol; not interchangeable with native mjlab GPU training results or accepted leaderboard scores. Surviving-prefix errors must be accompanied by coverage.

position_alignment_definition.no_alignment: raw world positions; no fitted or initial transform
position_alignment_definition.xy: subtract each actual/reference pelvis XY; keep absolute world Z and orientation
position_alignment_definition.xy_yaw: XY centering followed by closest world-Z rotation from actual to reference pelvis orientation; preserve Z and tilt
position_alignment_definition.yaw_rule: M=R_ref*R_actual^T; angle=atan2(M[1,0]-M[0,1],M[0,0]+M[1,1]); ambiguity if hypot of atan2 arguments <=1e-12; use angle=0, retain sample and expose fraction
position_alignment_definition.legacy_xyz: mpjpe_root_relative_world_axes_m remains a separately named translation-only compatibility diagnostic; not one of the three headline modes
position_alignment_definition.aggregation: mean Euclidean distance across the same 14 body origins, then mean over observed samples; includes failure sample; macro mean across clips; always report completion alongside prefix errors
